newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index closes higher buoyed by A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index closes higher buoyed by A shares.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B share index closed slightly higher on Monday in line with the A share market, led by speculative buying by institutions of shares with a heavy weighting on the index, brokers said.
The index rose 0.517 points or 0.82 percent to 63.354, on volume of 19.2 million shares worth $9.3 million compared with $8.8 million last Friday.
The domestic A share index rose 1.48 percent or 14.2 points to close at 974.146, on volume of 244 million worth 2.3 billion yuan compared with 2.1 billion yuan last Friday.
